## About
Automotive Performance Specialists is a family-owned and operated shop in Phoenix, handling vehicle maintenance and repairs with old fashioned values.
Our ASE-certified technicians use computer diagnostics to find out what's really going on, and we take the time to explain the repair so you understand it. Customers have rated us 4.9 on Google from 58 reviews.

## Services
- A/C system check: A complete A/C system check with a Freon top off to help you keep cool through a Phoenix summer.
- Brakes: Brake service to help you stay safe on the road.
- Maintenance and repairs: Bring us your car for all of your vehicle maintenance and repairs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer a military discount?
A: Yes. Get a 10 percent military discount when you present your ID at the time of write-up.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Who will be working on my car?
A: ASE-certified technicians, using computer diagnostics to find the problem.
